lesson: Wednesday's one bet landed: Club Brugge beat Lens 3-0 at about 2.05 for +$5.54. The read was simple: a settled, in-form home side against a Lens defence missing several starters. We stayed out of the other nine games, where injuries were already in the price or the favourite was too short.
